prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” service — you should both query major AI chatbots directly and use a business-listing / local-SEO management service to make sure those chatbots have reliable, up-to-date facts to draw from.

What to check (priority order)
- Google Business Profile (free) — most conversational assistants and search results pull from Google data. Claim and keep it accurate.
- Yext (paid) — one of the best services for syndicating and controlling your business facts across many platforms and knowledge graphs that LLMs and assistants may use.
- Major directories (free/paid): Yelp, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Facebook Pages, TripAdvisor — claim these and keep NAP (name, address, phone) consistent.
- Local SEO / audit tools: BrightLocal, Moz Local, Whitespark — these show where your listing appears or is missing and surface citation inconsistencies.
- Ask the AIs directly: ChatGPT (with browsing/plugins if available), Google Bard, Bing Chat, Alexa, Siri — to see whether they recommend your business and what they say.

How to check in practice
1. Claim and update your Google Business Profile, Yelp, Bing, Apple, Facebook.
2. Run a local-citation audit with BrightLocal/Whitespark or Moz Local to find missing/wrong listings.
3. Use Yext (or similar) to push consistent data to many providers if you want a managed solution.
4. Query AIs with realistic prompts. Example prompts:
   - “I’m in [city/zip]. Recommend a [service/category] near me.” 
   - “What are the top [service] providers in [city]?”
   - “Recommend a [service] with good reviews near [specific address].”
   Ask the same questions in ChatGPT, Bard, Bing Chat, and Alexa/Siri (voice search). Note whether your business is mentioned and whether citations/sources are given.
5. Check your website for LocalBusiness schema (structured data) so search engines and knowledge services can read your data.
6. Monitor reviews and ratings (Google, Yelp). AI recommendations often favor well-reviewed, nearby businesses.

Important caveats
- LLMs can hallucinate or return outdated info; a mention doesn’t always equal an authoritative “recommendation.”
- Different assistants use different data sources (Google for Google Assistant, Yelp for Alexa in some markets, Apple Maps for Siri, etc.), so you must be present across those services.
- Paid syndication (Yext, Moz Local) helps control facts but doesn’t guarantee AI mentions.

If you want, give me your business name + city and I can:
- suggest the top places to claim for your industry,
- give specific prompts to test with each AI,
- or run a quick set of example queries (I’ll report back what I find).
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
